# checkmk_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK rule by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a rule by its UUID
data "checkmk_rule" "example" {
  rule_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}

output "rule_description" {
  value = data.checkmk_rule.example.description
}

output "rule_ruleset" {
  value = data.checkmk_rule.example.ruleset
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (String) The rule ID to retrieve (UUID assigned by CheckMK).

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Optional comment for the rule.
- `description` (String) The rule description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is disabled.
- `folder` (String) The folder where this rule is defined.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the rule (same as rule_id).
- `ruleset` (String) The ruleset this rule belongs to.
- `value_raw` (String) The raw rule value as a Python literal string.
